in_english.name: Jannahaat
in_english.long_meaning: Jannahaat is a name that signifies gardens and paradises. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'j-n-n' (جَنَّ), which connotes the idea of a garden or paradise. In Islamic tradition, the term 'jannah' (جنة) refers to the Garden of Paradise. The name Jannahaat, therefore, embodies the spiritual meaning of a serene and beautiful abode. Historically, names derived from this root have been popular across Muslim cultures for their positive connotations of peace, beauty, and spiritual reward.
